proposedEntry.name: data-visualization-ux
proposedEntry.description: Directs chart and data-display design for product analytics, admin dashboards, reporting/monitoring UIs, and charts embedded in workflows. Instructs starting from the question the user needs answered, choosing chart types that match the data relationship (trend, comparison, part-to-whole, distribution), designing for scanning (clear titles, direct labels, restrained color), providing context (comparisons, time ranges, definitions), supporting drill-down/export, and handling empty/loading/sparse-data states. Warns against distorting axes/3D effects, relying on color alone, and skipping progressive disclosure for complexity. Verification checklist confirms the primary question is answerable in seconds and chart choice matches the data relationship.
inputs: data relationship and question the chart must answer
